whatIs.title: What is Random Number Picker?
whatIs.description: A tool that randomly selects numbers within a specified range. With the no-duplicates option, it ensures fair draws. Results are displayed dramatically with a slot-machine style animation.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Set the range using Min and Max values
Enter how many numbers to pick (1~50)
Choose whether to allow duplicates and a sort order
Click Draw to see results with a slot-machine animation
Use Quick Presets for Lotto, Parking, or Class number draws

tips.title: Tips
items: Lotto preset: picks 6 unique numbers from 1~45 to simulate lottery draws
Team assignment: pick numbers in the range of participant count
Allow duplicates mode: great for dice roll simulations
Use the Copy button to save results to clipboard and share
The last 10 draws are saved automatically in history

items.q: What is the difference between no-duplicates and allow-duplicates?
items.a: No-duplicates ensures each number appears only once; an error occurs if the count exceeds the range. Allow-duplicates lets the same number appear multiple times.

items.q: Can I use this to generate lottery numbers?
items.a: Yes, the Lotto preset (1~45, 6 picks, no duplicates) generates fair random numbers. However, there is no way to improve actual winning odds.
